data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman name Virgil, which is derived from the Latin word vir, meaning man. The name Virgilio is a Latin variant of Virgil and carries the same meaning: man of honor. The name Virgilio carries the meaning “Man of honor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Virgilio usually hope their child will grow to embody man of honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
